name: free_soft

preparation.initial_memory: psi=q=0 in the direct second-order causal formulation. Initial nonzero physical tails are retained and measured, not removed.

scope: Prepared spherical CFS evolution, with signed numerical boundary work. The receiver ledger alone is not a positive particle spectrum or actual cosmological source.

free_comparison.scope: Physical-region error against a large-domain sine-mode solution. Same-RK4 comparison separates the boundary from the bulk time error. Very fast reference-tail contamination is estimated separately.
